findings.text: Kept as advisory (Q2, boilerplate): isDirectory is written three times, here, in resolve.ts:23 and in checks.ts:582. Carried from round 1.
Kept as advisory (Q2): foldersByHand and projectFolders copy the module's folder listing. Carried from round 1.
Kept as advisory (Q2): adopt repeats underLeases's lease nesting from store.ts:187. Carried from round 1.
Kept as advisory (Q4/Q5): GitOptions.timeoutMs and resolveRepo's folderName are knobs only tests use. Carried from round 1.
Kept as advisory (Q8): moduleVersion and readEntry are exports only tests import. The rubric grades this advisory.
Kept as advisory (Q9): the ?? "" fallback is for a key the map always holds.
Kept as advisory (Q8): the re-export of requireSchema from store.ts has no importer. Every caller imports it from schema.ts.
Kept as advisory (Q5/Q3): fileHash is an alias that only forwards to hashOf, and store.ts uses both names for the same hash.
Kept as advisory (Q2): onDisk re-implements the exported existsOnDisk (repo.ts:119).
Kept as advisory (Q3): the inner const written shadows the outer written at line 303, and the two mean different things.
Kept as advisory (Q10): change's doc comment describes a repos parameter the function does not have.

Kept as advisory (Q3): every path with no written hash counts as edited, so the message at line 969 can claim a change that never happened. Checked against probes/partly-written-operation.md case 3, which confirms the wrong sentence: the tree is right, only the message is wrong. The risk gate notes the same.
Kept as advisory (Q5/Q2): DoctorContext.gitVersion is a knob only tests set. Line 659 and requireGit (repo.ts:379) format the minimum git version differently.
Kept as advisory (Q2): clipLine re-implements clip from src/util/text.ts but drops its surrogate-pair guard.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the line is outside the change. The diff repeats the db as Db pattern at checks.ts:628, which the architecture gate notes.

Lowered from defect to advisory. The reviewer is right that no test covers a file added during commit's git add and git commit, after the undisturbed check at store.ts:300. But the code no longer promises that window: ADR 0024:162 states it as a known limit with a remedy (the file stays untracked, doctor reports it, adopt indexes it), and the data gate grades it advisory this round. Checked: the round-1 defect's fix is the undisturbed check that keeps settle from recording a fingerprint when the folders changed before the commit, and this test fails if that check is removed. Rubric Q1 asks for a test of each behaviour the criteria promise. It does not ask for a test of a stated limit. The ADR's description of that window is inexact (data F-2).
Kept as advisory (Q5): the rebuild-order test depends on the renewal count and on the order of internal calls. It still fails on reversion.
Kept as advisory: at this level only the version probe times out (AC-8). The runner-level test still covers the timeout.
Kept as advisory: AC-8's 'killed' is checked only through the 'timed out' message.
Kept as advisory (Q5): the parent-repository check is weak (AC-2). The environment test at line 395 holds the ceiling guard.
Kept as advisory: stderr clipping is checked on the thrown message, not on the log line (AC-13).
Kept as advisory: the gained-remote test resolves through the row, not the manifest (AC-2). The test at line 101 checks that the manifest learns the remote.

Upheld (Q1, boundary; breaks AC-19 and AC-15). Checked: the header regex at line 458 consumes only the first section header. Line 463 sets line to the rest of the line, and the key regex at line 465 needs a letter, so a second header on the same line, [core][filter "x"], is never looked up in REFUSED_SECTIONS. Run in probes/security-round-two.md case 1 (git 2.54.0): git reads filter.x.clean from that line, checkRepoConfig and openRepo return, and the program runs on statusOf and on stagePaths. The same trick hides include, includeIf and a diff driver's textconv. Who: anyone who can drop a folder under <data dir>/knowledge/. With what: a .git/config and a .gitattributes. What they get: a program run under the person's identity on any write, adopt or doctor.

Upheld (Q1, boundary; breaks AC-19 and AC-15). Checked: statusOf runs git status without --ignore-submodules=all, and nothing refuses a gitlink in the dropped index or reads a nested repository's configuration. Run in probes/security-round-two.md case 2: with a gitlink at entries/sub and a nested repository whose configuration holds a filter, refuseForeign, checkRepoConfig and openRepo all return, and statusOf runs the nested repository's program. This path is reached on rebuild and list (changedPaths), on adopt and on doctor.

Upheld (Q1, boundary; breaks AC-19). Checked: openRepo calls checkRepoConfig (line 635) before revertInterrupted (line 636). restoreKept's guard at line 885 refuses only empty, '.' and '..' parts, so a path of .git/config named in a dropped intent record and its kept-bytes file is written after the check. Run in probes/security-round-two.md case 3: git reset -q -- .git/config does not fail, .git/config gets the filter after openRepo, and the next git add runs the program. The fix is to refuse any path outside entries/, proposals/ and the root files (or any path whose first part is .git), on restore and on revert.
Kept as advisory (A-6, hardening): createRepository writes .gitignore, and taxonomy.md when it is missing, with a plain writeFileSync that follows a link.
Kept as advisory (A-7, defence in depth): undoStaged runs rmSync on created paths without the '.'/'..' guard. Today git rejects such paths first.

Kept as advisory (Q3). Checked: landed is decided once for all paths. A landed commit with a later edit to one of its paths is treated as not landed, so an adopt's other files get their pre-rewrite bytes back. Nothing is lost: the rewrite is in HEAD and the bytes are the person's. No test covers the case.

Kept as advisory (Q1): the stderr report can describe the wrong thing. probes/partly-written-operation.md case 3 confirms that a path the operation never wrote is reported as 'changed after it; run ... adopt'. The tree is left right, so this is a misleading message, not an unseen failure. The code-quality gate notes the same at line 947.
Kept as advisory: the module migration pass is not contained, and doctor does not warn on 'behind'. Now stated as a known limit (ADR 0024:163).
Kept as advisory: the rollback is stated with its reason but is manual, and the pre-drop backup rotates away (ADR 0024:164). The rubric grades a manual rollback advisory.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the upgrade runner's 10 s wait under BEGIN IMMEDIATE predates this item.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the p95 hook-latency flakiness predates this item. Names no line of the diff.

Kept as advisory, at the reviewer's grade (Q5). Checked: ensureRepo, then openRepo, then learnAliases (repo.ts:585-609) commits knowledge.json while only the root's lease is held, under withRepoLeases at line 187. The repository's own lease is taken at line 204. This is against spec.md:137 and learnAliases's own comment. Today it is serialised against writes by the root lease, not against rebuild, list or a revert.
Kept as advisory: the function-level import cycles repo↔resolve and repo↔author are still there, and the change widened the first. They are safe at runtime.

Kept as advisory: doctor still builds a store by hand with db as Db and lists the folders itself. It also never calls refuseForeign, so readRepoFiles (line 784) follows a linked entries or proposals folder.

Kept as advisory: three Design details differ from spec.md (proposal problem ids, the wider config refusal list, refuseForeign and learnAliases). ADR 0024 records each one, and none crosses a boundary. Amend the spec's Design.
Lowered to advisory, debt: outside the change. The viewer's SettingKey type omits WIZARDINGCODE_MODULES and WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_AUTHOR.
Lowered to advisory, debt: outside the change. It has no forward reference to ADR 0024.

Kept as advisory (Q3). Checked: settle records the fingerprint after the files are written and committed, so a file added after the undisturbed check at line 300 is counted and not read. This is stated as a known limit (ADR 0024:162). The file stays on disk, untracked, and doctor and adopt surface it, so no row is lost for good.

Kept as advisory (Q3): the known limit says 'a few milliseconds'. The window actually opens at store.ts:300, before writeFileAtomic, git add and git commit, so it lasts as long as those git calls. Name the real span.

Kept as advisory (Q1): the drop is irreversible, with a stated reason and a backup first, and the backup rotates under BACKUPS_KEPT = 2. The test now creates the triggers and the indexes, so the drop is shown by a run.
Kept as advisory (Q6): a one-time VACUUM INTO under the write lock on stores that ran the withdrawn module. Stated.
Kept as advisory (Q2): project_aliases is read by project_id with no index. The table is small and the read is off the hook path.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the missing project_id index on project_aliases predates the change.
